thread:
raj.patel: heads up — we lost 3 gpu nodes in eu-west1 after the egress-acl change at 11:03 UTC. autoscaler says healthcheck failures.

michelle.gomez: seeing same. kubelet / healthz probes failing with 502 from envoy sidecar.

raj.patel: logs from node-gtx-12:
```
[envoy] 2026-03-18T11:05:23Z envoy proxy egress: rejected request to https://eu-west1-s3.s3.amazonaws.com/...?signature=...
action=route_reject, reason=host_mismatch
```

sara.li: @raj can you paste the egress policy yaml? suspect host-based allowlist + TLS termination.

raj.patel: sure — we narrowed it to this rule:
```
apiVersion: networking/v1
kind: EgressPolicy
spec:
  allowHosts:
    - api.redwood-inference.internal
    - quay.io
  tlsInspect: true
  enforceL7: true
```

sara.li: ah — enforceL7 with tlsInspect will match hostnames. presigned S3 urls use randomized hostnames (sig+host) and are failing host checks. autoscaler healthchecks fetch metadata and docker registry pulls to provision gpu nodes also use ephemeral hostnames.

clara-ops: confirm: node bootstrap pulls images from gcr/quay and hits signed urls from our model storage. blocked => kubelet image pulls/timeouts => node not Ready => autoscaler removes

raj.patel: exactly. also saw errors to control plane metrics endpoint via signed URLs: TLS handshake aborted: envoy tried to match SNI against allowHosts and returned 403.

deploy-bot: [alert] cluster-autoscaler: node node-gtx-12 removed (timeout health checks)

michelle.gomez: quick mitigation — rolled back egress policy to previous commit (reverted enforceL7 + keep allowlist to IPs for control-plane). nodes are rejoining now.

raj.patel: nodes back online. follow-up: we need policy that allows TLS passthrough for registries and presigned hosts, or expand to allow known IP ranges for storage providers. also add explicit exceptions for autoscaler control-plane endpoints.

sara.li: ok will open infra ticket with proposed change: 1) add passthrough mode for L7 TLS when host matches pattern (quay/gcr/s3-prefixed), 2) separate rule for autoscaler health endpoints by IP+port, 3) add test harness that simulates presigned-URL image pulls.

clara-ops: assigning to eng-infra. cc @security for review of widening egress.

raj.patel: thanks — also add k8s integration test that simulates node bootstrap under egress policy to avoid regressions :thumbsup:

michelle.gomez: filing postmortem draft now.

autoscaler-bot: [info] action required: follow-up ticket INFRA-1248 created by sara.li
